features: motorized pan 0-350 deg, tilt 0-90 deg, 360 view with preset patrol
AI human and vehicle detection with auto tracking (Anchor System)
Wi-Fi 6 dual-band (IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz) + Bluetooth pairing
Smart Dual Light: IR + warm light up to 30 m, WizColor NEO full-color
red and blue warning light active deterrence
microSD up to 512 GB + Dahua Cloud, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua Picoo P5X is a 5MP Wi-Fi 6 dual-band pan & tilt camera with 360-degree coverage, AI auto tracking, WizColor NEO full-color night vision, and red/blue active deterrence. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

frigate.notes: DMSS app-only consumer camera; ONVIF/RTSP not listed in the datasheet, so no documented RTSP path.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi camera; ONVIF not confirmed. Add via DMSS; use the Generic Camera integration only if an RTSP stream is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: Try the 'Dahua' profile; RTSP is not documented for this consumer model.
